precision: row INT8, full vocabulary, FP32 activations/KV
input_control: Identical UTF-8 prompt bytes and caps for all four models. Story continuation, not ending instruction. Chat wrapper is native to TinyTalk, not SFT.
hypotheses: Story objective may preserve coherent continuation without improving Q&A.
TinyTalk-2 may improve Q&A versus TinyTalk 1, confounded by both size and training changes.
Independent request dispatch should increase aggregate throughput without changing outputs.

story.topic_continuity: 0 absent/wrong; 1 partial; 2 both listed topic components continued
story.coherence: 0 contradictory/incoherent; 1 noticeable contradiction or unexplained shift; 2 no material contradiction in visible text
story.narrated_resolution: 0 no resolution; 1 visible narrative resolution (EOS alone insufficient)

rubric.question: First substantive factual answer correct, not mere lexical presence. Q1-Q3 also score one-short-sentence format.
rubric.instruction: I1/I2 stripped exact case-insensitive full output. I3 one short rain sentence, no animals.
rubric.memory_unknown_language: Descriptive manual inspection, no aggregate assistant claim.

quality_limits: One greedy generation per model/task, same unblinded assistant rates all. Elementary facts/subjects may overlap training. No held-out or statistical-quality claim.

hardware.one_board: All 16 cases on peer after known control and model-ID check
modes: master plus one peer two jobs
hardware.order: AB/BA alternates by block; models SFT, story8, talk1, talk2 (not randomized)
hardware.timing: Master monotonic created-to-last-finished package time; includes queue/prefill/transport. Actual outputs, tokens/s and Unicode characters/s.
hardware.restoration: TinyTalk-2 on both; peer configured; no active jobs
